_comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/auditGate.mjs (run with --omit-dev: a static SPA ships only production deps, so build/dev-tooling advisories are not the deployed attack surface). Each entry has an EXPIRY: past it the gate treats the advisory as a fresh offender. A brand-new production high/critical not listed here fails CI immediately. TODO: re-evaluate react-router in a deps PR once a fixed 7.x (or a planned 8.x migration) is available.

1124276.reason: Unauthenticated DoS in react-router's SERVER data routers / SSR handler. This app is a pure client-side SPA (BrowserRouter, no SSR/RSC), so the vulnerable server path is never executed. Fix lands only outside our ^7 range. Tracked for deps PR.

1138769.reason: CSRF bypass specific to react-router RSC (React Server Components) mode, which this SPA does not use. Not exploitable in a client-only build. Fix lands only outside our ^7 range. Tracked for deps PR.
